description: For `process_deposit`, on success the shares minted must equal `amount` when vault.shares == vault.assets before the call and floor(amount * shares_before / assets_before) otherwise, with vault.shares increased by exactly that number and vault.assets increased by exactly `amount`; any other value means shares are mispriced against the vault's current share/asset ratio.
title: deposit_mints_shares_at_current_ratio

description: For both `process_deposit` and `process_deposit_exact`, the assets backing each pre-existing share must not decrease — assets_after * shares_before >= assets_before * shares_after — otherwise a depositor pays less than the fair backing for the shares they receive and silently extracts value from existing holders (note `process_deposit_exact` recomputes assets with the floor-rounding `convert_shares_to_assets` rather than `convert_shares_to_assets_ceil`).
title: deposit_never_dilutes_existing_shareholders

description: If vault.shares <= vault.assets holds before `process_deposit` or `process_deposit_exact`, it must still hold after the handler returns successfully; violating it means the vault records more outstanding shares than assets to back them and later redeemers cannot be paid.
title: deposits_preserve_vault_solvency

description: `process_deposit` must revert when `user_assets_account` is the same account as `vault_assets_account` (the guard is present but commented out, while `process_deposit_exact` enforces it): with a self-transfer the token CPI moves no tokens, yet vault.assets and vault.shares are both increased, so the caller mints shares backed by assets that never entered the vault.
title: deposit_must_reject_self_transfer

description: In `process_deposit` and `process_deposit_exact`, the asset amount requested in the SPL transfer CPI (source `user_assets_account`, destination `vault_assets_account`, authority = the signing `authority`) must equal the increase in vault.assets, and the amount in the `mint_to` CPI (mint = vault.shares_mint, destination `user_shares_account`) must equal the increase in vault.shares; a mismatch makes the vault's ledger diverge from the real token balances.
title: deposit_cpi_amounts_match_recorded_state_deltas

description: If, before `process_deposit` or `process_deposit_exact`, vault.assets + vault.fee_amount <= the `amount` field of the SPL token account data of `vault_assets_account`, the same relation must hold afterwards; breaking it means the vault credits itself assets it does not hold, which no later instruction can reconcile downward (update_reward only syncs upward).
title: recorded_assets_remain_backed_by_token_balance

description: `process_deposit_exact` must never transfer more asset tokens out of `user_assets_account` than the `amount` instruction argument (assets_to_vault <= amount), since the whole point of the exact variant is to take only what is needed to back the minted shares; taking more pulls unauthorized tokens from the depositor.
title: exact_deposit_never_takes_more_than_requested

description: `process_deposit` and `process_deposit_exact` must fail unless both the number of shares minted and the number of assets added to the vault are strictly positive, so that a caller can neither surrender assets for zero shares nor obtain shares without contributing assets.
title: deposit_rejects_zero_share_or_zero_asset_move

description: `process_deposit` and `process_deposit_exact` must leave every Vault field other than `shares` and `assets` byte-identical — admin, slash_admin, shares_mint, assets_mint, vault_assets_account, vault_shares_mint_bump, vault_assets_account_bump, fee_bps, fee_amount and fee_token_account — since the vault is written through a zero-copy bytemuck cast and a wrong write would silently reassign authorities or PDAs.
title: deposit_leaves_vault_configuration_unchanged

description: `process_deposit` and `process_deposit_exact` must reject a `vault_info` account whose owner is not the vault program (and whose data is not a valid, initialized Vault): `VaultInfo::try_from` only reinterprets the raw bytes with `bytemuck::from_bytes` and checks assets_mint != shares_mint, so an attacker can supply a look-alike account they control with an arbitrary shares/assets ratio and arbitrary recorded mint/token-account keys to drive share minting.
title: deposit_must_reject_foreign_owned_vault_account

description: `process_deposit` and `process_deposit_exact` must revert if the `authority` account is not a signer, since that account is used as the transfer authority over `user_assets_account`; without the check the program becomes a confused deputy that moves a third party's asset tokens.
title: deposit_requires_authority_signature

description: When vault.fee_bps != 0, the fee-free variants `process_deposit` and `process_deposit_exact` should not succeed (the `require!(fee.is_zero())` check exists but is commented out in `vault_deposit_assets`); otherwise any depositor can simply call the standard deposit instruction instead of the fee-charging one and the protocol never collects the configured fee.
title: standard_deposit_must_not_bypass_configured_fee

description: `process_deposit` must be able to complete successfully for a well-formed call — distinct `user_assets_account` and `vault_assets_account`, a signing `authority`, the correct vault-derived `vault_assets_account`/`shares_mint` PDAs, a solvent vault and an `amount` large enough to yield a nonzero share count — so that the accumulated guards do not render the deposit path dead.
title: legitimate_deposit_is_reachable

description: From a vault state where shares == 0 and assets > 0 (reachable by donating tokens plus `update_reward`, or by full redemption after reward accrual), `process_deposit` and `process_deposit_exact` compute floor(amount * 0 / assets) = 0 shares for every `amount` and then fail in `mint_shares`, permanently bricking deposits and leaving the residual assets unredeemable; a correct implementation should fall back to a 1:1 (or other well-defined) bootstrap ratio in that state.
title: deposit_dead_when_shares_zero_but_assets_positive

description: For `process_deposit` and `process_deposit_exact`, the assets taken from the depositor (the increase in vault.assets, equal to the amount in the SPL transfer CPI) must not exceed the pre-state value of the shares minted rounded up — assets_delta * shares_before <= shares_minted * assets_before when shares_before != assets_before (rounding the right-hand side up), and assets_delta <= shares_minted when shares_before == assets_before — otherwise the depositor surrenders assets that the shares they receive do not entitle them to reclaim, and that value is silently donated to pre-existing shareholders; this is exactly the inflation-attack loss the 'exact' variant is meant to remove, and `process_deposit` takes the full `amount` regardless of how far floor(amount * shares_before / assets_before) truncates.
title: deposit_never_overcharges_depositor_for_shares

description: If, before `process_deposit` or `process_deposit_exact`, vault.shares equals the `supply` field of the `shares_mint` account, the equality must still hold after the handler returns successfully (checking this requires a model of the SPL Token mint_to CPI, the same modelling assumption the assets-side backing property already makes; the bound here is a single mint account): if vault.shares falls below the circulating share supply the vault will not honour every outstanding share token and the last redeemers cannot be paid, and if it rises above the supply the vault reserves assets against shares nobody holds, stranding them permanently.
title: vault_shares_equals_shares_mint_supply

description: Spanning a sequence of two transactions: a `process_deposit` (or `process_deposit_exact`) that mints S shares and takes A assets, followed immediately by a `process_redeem_shares` of exactly those S shares on the same vault with no instruction in between, must return at most A assets to the user; if it can return more, the floor/ceil asymmetry between `convert_assets_to_shares` and `convert_shares_to_assets` lets anyone repeatedly cycle deposit-and-redeem to extract assets from the vault with no capital at risk, draining existing shareholders.
title: deposit_then_redeem_is_not_profitable

description: For `process_deposit` and `process_deposit_exact`, when the `vault_assets_account` SPL token account holds strictly more tokens than `vault.assets + vault.fee_amount` before the call (an accrued reward or plain donation that the permissionless `process_update_reward` has not yet recognized), the handler prices shares off the stale recorded `vault.assets` and mints floor(amount * shares / assets_recorded) shares instead of the fair floor(amount * shares / real_balance), handing the new depositor a pro-rata claim on the unrecognized tokens; the rule to check is that after either handler succeeds, token_balance_after * shares_before >= token_balance_before * shares_after, where token_balance is the `amount` field of the `vault_assets_account` token account, and a violation means existing shareholders' claim on the vault's real holdings is diluted by the incoming depositor (this reuses the SPL-token-account model that the existing backing property already assumes; the bound is one token account).
title: deposit_prices_shares_against_stale_asset_balance
